entries.stance: The WNBA's inability to define 'woman' is a farce, and male players exploiting it are a joke.

entries.stance: Corporate surveillance is out of control, and people are fighting back in creative ways.
exemplars: 🚨 BREAKING NEWS: Florida man just casually walked away with a full Flock surveillance camera… still bolted to a 12-foot pole… while draped in the American flag 🇺🇸 Security followed him like lost puppies. This is either the most based thing You’ll see all year or pure chaos. Is this what peak freedom looks like in 2026? Would you have the balls to do this? Hero… or criminal? Drop your honest take below. Let me know what You think, and SHARE THIS so that others may too! And if You're not already Following @TrueOnX ... What the heck are You doing?!

🚨 #BREAKING : A grand jury has REFUSED TO INDICT an man for destroying a Flock camera in Ohio. Cody Morelock allegedly brought down the camera, solar panel and support pole before destroying them. A grand jury wouldn't indict him and the charges have been dismissed.

Despite video evidence Cody Morelock was found NOT GUILTY of destroying a Flock camera, after an Ohio Grand Jury found him NOT GUILTY, this is an example of Jury Nullification. Now LISTEN closely. A jury can "Nullify" a trial even if they think someone is guilty but here's the secret, YOU CANNOT ADMIT TO THE JUDGE THIS IS WHAT YOU ARE DOING—if at any moment you indicate to the judge you are declaring someone "not guilty" despite knowing he is guilty of a crime, he can throw out the verdict, HOWEVER there is an easy fix. Simply tell the Judge: "You're honor, we find the defendant NOT GUILTY." If the Judge questions the jury simply say: "We (the Jury) just don't think he's guilty." And leave it at that—this is JURY NULLIFICATION in action and its the best kept secret in the US Legal/Court System. Why Jury Nullification is so important: Just because something is legal doesn't make it good. (Just because its the law doesn't make it just) It's very clear MOST people do NOT support or want Flock Cameras and as much as the government tries to GASLIGHT you or use Force/Threats of Violence (or otherwise) to convince you that you "have" to listen to them—the truth is you don't. Authority is derived from the consent of the governed—not the threat of violence. Power and Justice should serve the needs of The People—not the other way around. Ultimately its THE PEOPLE who decide whether or not someone is "guilty" or not, not the courts, not the Judge, not the system, not the government, but THE PEOPLE. Never forget that its the Jury that decides. That's Jury Nullification.
